Less cheerful: a Premier League panel has ruled the shirt pull on Isak in the Liverpool game should have been a penalty, and the Man City 115 charges appeal verdict has thrown fresh questions over the title race. On the brighter side, Viktor Gyokeres has hit back at his critics with Graham Potter in his corner, and Piero Hincapie has cleared up his injury status after a freak accident.
